content: The J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall continue the sequence by subsequent calling the Dem_J1939DcmGetNextFilteredRatio, till the return ed value is ‘ DEM_NO_SUCH_ELEMENT ’. The calls may spread over several calls of J1939Dcm_MainFunction.
